name: Eye for Smugglers
text: Your time checking seemingly innocent cargo ships for illicit goods has made you as canny as you are suspicious. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to locate hidden panels, secret doors or hatches, concealed objects, and similar items (at the GM's discretion). If you aren't using the Seek action or Searching, the GM automatically rolls a secret check for you to notice these types of objects when you pass within 10 feet of them.
